sehemu: Part IV: High Court of Zanzibar
maudhui: For purposes of interpreting this Chapter of this Constitution, it is hereby declared that the provisions contained in this Chapter shall not prevent the continued existence or establishment, in accordance with the laws applicable in Zanzibar, of the High Court of Zanzibar or courts subordinate to the High Court of Zanzibar.
